description: Source code for pcap_file_writer class, handling PCAP file writing, including opening, closing, flushing, and writing packet data and headers.

classes.name: pcap_file_writer
classes.description: Class responsible for writing PCAP files, including handling headers, data packets, and export PDUs.

methods.name: open
methods.description: Opens a PCAP file for writing, initializes headers.

methods.name: flush
methods.description: Flushes the output stream if open.

methods.name: close
methods.description: Closes the PCAP file, after flushing.

methods.name: write_pdu_header
methods.description: Writes a packet header with timestamp and length info.

methods.name: write_exported_pdu_header
methods.description: Writes header for exported PDU, including dissector name.

methods.name: write_pdu
methods.description: Writes a PDU from a span of bytes.

methods.name: write_pdu
methods.description: Writes a PDU from a byte_buffer object.
